Vision 2030 Strategic Partnership

Co-Investment Framework

Humantic Digital is a MISA-licensed investment entity operating a dedicated, Vision 2030-aligned KSA enablement programme. We co-fund strategic organisational capability programmes across key institutions in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Investment Record in Saudi Arabia throughout 2023-2026

Humantic Digital has co-invested in and funded human-capability development programmes, including fully funded British professional certification programmes for qualifying Saudi institutions and beneficiaries.

To date, this investment and programme activity includes:

  • 140 programme days delivered over 7 months across 5 healthcare institutions associated with the Ministry of National Guard Health Affairs and hospitals owned by His Majesty King Salman.

Humantic AI – Align

Core features: what the team actually sees

HumanticDIGITAL
Shared Team Board

One board for the whole team, grouped by project or priority. Every card shows its owner, due date and status.

One Owner per Task

Every task has one accountable owner. Align AI flags unassigned work and suggests who should take it.

AI Capture Inbox

Forward an email or paste a note. Align AI drafts a clear task with an owner and due date for one-tap approval.

Smart Priority Ranking

Each person's list is ranked by real urgency, dependencies and objectives, so the most important request wins.

Follow-Up & Waiting-For Tracker

Replies, approvals and handovers owed by others are tracked automatically, with polite reminders sent for you.

Meeting-to-Action

Paste meeting notes and Align AI pulls out decisions, owners and deadlines onto the board.

A Thread on Every Card

Comment, tag a colleague or ask for a status update on the card, in one searchable thread.

Calm Communication

Suggests a calm, respectful version of sensitive or overdue follow-ups, so hard conversations start well.

Weekly Reset

Every Sunday evening, each person and manager gets an AI-built review of what closed, what is stuck and what is due.

Productivity & Wellbeing Index

A workload and wellbeing view for each person, and a team view so managers can spot overload before burnout.

  2. Keep top talent at their best, before disengagement sets in.
  3. See what is slowing each person down, through individualised performance derailers.

PresenceStoryRoom

Stay present with impact.

Learning outcomes

From raw numbers to a message people act on.

Participants learn to find the insight in the data, build the story around it, and present it with clarity and confidence. AI is built into the practice day: every participant is evaluated live by AI on the Present with Intelligence platform and receives a personalised performance-gap report. It is Human-AI evaluation.

Why this programme

Reports and dashboards only matter when someone acts on them.

Most professionals already have the data. What decides whether a project, a proposal or a pitch lands is how clearly it is framed, how well it fits the audience, and how calmly it is delivered when questions start.

Participants work on their own projects and presentations, so what they practise is what they present next, in the boardroom, to stakeholders or to decision-makers.

Evaluated live

How every presentation is evaluated, live.

Each participant presents on the Present with Intelligence board: the presenter at the centre, every evaluation point linked to what the audience sees and hears, with the live score and AI evaluation alongside.

Experts in behavioral analysis and human sciences evaluate it through one-on-one evaluation sessions of 1 hour each, scheduled with every participant. It is Human-AI: human and machine intelligence.

Sound familiar?

What participants feel now, and what they leave able to do.

“I lose my words mid-sentence.”
They leave able to

Hold the thread under pressure, with one anchor message to return to.

“I can’t get my message across.”
They leave able to

Lead with the answer, so the point lands in the first minute.

“An interruption wears away my calm.”
They leave able to

Welcome the question, pause, and take the room back.

Lead any boardroom you walk into.
